content.json:
## Microsoft Copilot Activity Monitoring
---

This workbook provides comprehensive monitoring and analysis of Microsoft Copilot activities including user interactions, plugin management, and security events.

parameters.name: RecordType
parameters.label: Record Type
parameters.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| distinct RecordType
| order by RecordType asc

parameters.name: AppIdentity
parameters.label: App Identity
parameters.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isnotempty(AppIdentity)
| distinct AppIdentity
| order by AppIdentity asc

parameters.name: ActorName
parameters.label: User (Actor)
parameters.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| distinct ActorName
| order by ActorName asc

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where '*' in ({RecordType}) or RecordType in ({RecordType})
| where '*' in ({AppIdentity}) or AppIdentity in ({AppIdentity}) or isempty(AppIdentity)
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| summarize count() by RecordType
content.title: All Events

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where '*' in ({RecordType}) or RecordType in ({RecordType})
| where '*' in ({AppIdentity}) or AppIdentity in ({AppIdentity}) or isempty(AppIdentity)
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), RecordType
| render timechart
content.title: Activity Timeline by Record Type

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where '*' in ({RecordType}) or RecordType in ({RecordType})
| where '*' in ({AppIdentity}) or AppIdentity in ({AppIdentity}) or isempty(AppIdentity)
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| summarize Count = count() by RecordType
| order by Count desc
| render piechart
content.title: Activity Distribution by Type

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where '*' in ({RecordType}) or RecordType in ({RecordType})
| where '*' in ({AppIdentity}) or AppIdentity in ({AppIdentity}) or isempty(AppIdentity)
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| summarize TotalActivities = count(),
            Interactions = countif(RecordType == "CopilotInteraction"),
            PluginActions = countif(RecordType in ("CreateCopilotPlugin", "EnableCopilotPlugin", "DisableCopilotPlugin")),
            LastActivity = max(TimeGenerated),
            FirstActivity = min(TimeGenerated)
            by ActorName, ActorUserType
| extend DaysSinceFirstActivity = datetime_diff('day', now(), FirstActivity)
| order by TotalActivities desc
| project ActorName, ActorUserType, TotalActivities, Interactions, PluginActions, LastActivity, DaysSinceFirstActivity
content.title: Top Users by Activity

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where RecordType in ("CreateCopilotPlugin", "EnableCopilotPlugin", "DisableCopilotPlugin")
| where '*' in ({AppIdentity}) or AppIdentity in ({AppIdentity}) or isempty(AppIdentity)
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| extend LLMData = parse_json(LLMEventData)
| extend WorkspaceName = tostring(LLMData.Workspace.Name)
| extend Resource = tostring(LLMData.Resource[0].Property)
| extend OriginalValue = tostring(LLMData.Resource[0].OriginalValue)
| extend NewValue = tostring(LLMData.Resource[0].NewValue)
| project TimeGenerated, ActorName, RecordType, AppIdentity, WorkspaceName, Resource, OriginalValue, NewValue
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Plugin Management Events

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where RecordType in ("CreateCopilotPlugin", "EnableCopilotPlugin", "DisableCopilotPlugin")
| where '*' in ({AppIdentity}) or AppIdentity in ({AppIdentity}) or isempty(AppIdentity)
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), RecordType
| render timechart
content.title: Plugin Management Timeline

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where RecordType == "CopilotInteraction"
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| where isnotempty(AIModelName)
| summarize Interactions = count(),
            UniqueUsers = dcount(ActorName),
            LastUsed = max(TimeGenerated)
            by AIModelName, AppHost
| order by Interactions desc
content.title: AI Model Usage Statistics

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where RecordType == "CopilotInteraction"
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| where isnotempty(AppHost)
| summarize Count = count() by AppHost
| order by Count desc
| render piechart
content.title: Usage by Application Host

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where RecordType == "CopilotInteraction"
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| extend LLMData = parse_json(LLMEventData)
| mv-expand Message = LLMData.Messages
| extend JailbreakDetected = tobool(Message.JailbreakDetected)
| where JailbreakDetected == true
| project TimeGenerated, ActorName, AppHost, AIModelName, MessageId = tostring(Message.Id), IsPrompt = tobool(Message.isPrompt)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: ⚠️ Jailbreak Detection Events
content.noDataMessage: No jailbreak attempts detected in the selected time range

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where '*' in ({RecordType}) or RecordType in ({RecordType})
| where '*' in ({AppIdentity}) or AppIdentity in ({AppIdentity}) or isempty(AppIdentity)
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize Events = count(), 
            UniqueUsers = dcount(ActorName),
            RecordTypes = make_set(RecordType),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by SrcIpAddr
| order by Events desc
| take 20
content.title: Top Source IP Addresses

content.query:
CopilotActivity
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where '*' in ({RecordType}) or RecordType in ({RecordType})
| where '*' in ({AppIdentity}) or AppIdentity in ({AppIdentity}) or isempty(AppIdentity)
| where '*' in ({ActorName}) or ActorName in ({ActorName})
| project TimeGenerated, 
          RecordType, 
          ActorName, 
          ActorUserType,
          AppHost,
          AppIdentity,
          AIModelName,
          SrcIpAddr,
          Workload,
          LLMEventData
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.title: Recent Copilot Activities (Last 500 Events)
